subject: Medivio — subscription rollforward & isolated site onboarding
messages:
From: Nina Shah <nina.shah@medivio.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@medivio.com
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Upcoming subscription rollforward — request for isolated on-prem site

Olga,

We’re coming up on our December renewal and need to confirm a change to the scope: Medivio needs an isolated on‑prem deployment (air‑gapped option) for our analytics cluster to process PHI. We currently have Redwood Private in a VPC for prod, but the clinical analytics team must run in an on‑prem environment with strict network isolation.

Key asks:
- Add one isolated on‑prem cluster (8xA40 equivalent) with dedicated KV cache and isolated KMS.
- Extend the current subscription term from 12 to 24 months with a one‑time onboarding credit applied at renewal.
- SOC2 evidence and architecture checklist for audit.

Can you confirm whether this is feasible for our current renewal date (2027‑01‑15)? Procurement copied on this thread — they’ll need a contract amendment and an updated SOW. I’ve attached our current invoice for reference.

Thanks,
Nina Shah
Director, Cloud Ops — Medivio Health
Attachments: medivio-current-invoice.pdf
From: olga_petrov@redwood.com
To: Nina Shah <nina.shah@medivio.com>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Upcoming subscription rollforward — request for isolated on-prem site

Nina — thanks for the clear summary. This is doable but will touch cross‑functional teams (on‑prem packaging, security/compliance, and commercial). Next steps I propose:

1) Technical scoping call (Camila will lead) — inventory the isolation requirements (KMS, network, backups).
2) Commercial amendment — Rishi will draft the term/credit proposal and outline pricing impact for the additional cluster.
3) Procurement artifacts — we’ll attach SOC2 + deployment checklist for your auditors.

Can we set a 45‑minute technical/ops call this week? I’m available Thu 12/3 11:00–12:00 PT or Fri 12/4 09:00–10:00 PT. Camila — can you prepare an initial on‑prem checklist and high level rollout phases?

Olga Petrov
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555‑0187
From: camila_reyes@redwood.com
To: Nina Shah <nina.shah@medivio.com>, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Upcoming subscription rollforward — request for isolated on-prem site

Nina / Olga — jumping in with the technical plan after our quick sync prep notes. High level:

- Two‑phase delivery: 1) Pilot node (proof of isolation + perf validation) in your staging datacenter (~3 weeks). 2) Production cluster onboarding and handover (~4 weeks).
- Requirements from Medivio: onsite network whitelist for pre‑deployment tests, KMS integration details (HSM connector or cloud KMS export), maintenance window windows for cutover.
- We will deliver: deployment checklist, runbook, measurable SLO targets for latency and throughput, and a hardened OS image.

Preliminary timeline (subject to PO and access):
• Week 0–1: SOW sign and procurement kickoff
• Week 2–4: Pilot provisioning and validation
• Week 5–8: Production rollout and post‑deployment audit

Attachments: onprem-deploy-checklist.pdf (contains required IP ranges, ports, and configuration templates).

Let me know any constraints on your side (approvals, backup retention policy) that would change the timeline.

—Camila
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: Nina Shah <nina.shah@medivio.com>, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@medivio.com
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Commercial proposal: term amendment & onboarding credit

Nina — following up on pricing/terms. Based on the proposed isolated cluster (8x capacity) and 24‑month term:

- One‑time onboarding fee: $28,000 (covers pre‑deploy, packaging, pilot validation).
- Monthly subscription for added isolated capacity: $18,500/mo (billed monthly) — discount applied for 24‑month commit.
- One‑time onboarding credit at renewal: $15,000 applied against the first invoice after amendment execution.

I can convert this into an amendment doc and SOW. If procurement can provide a PO number and standard billing contact, we’ll attach a line‑item SOW for signatures. If you’d like different amortization (annual vs monthly), we can model that too.

Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: procurement@medivio.com
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: Nina Shah <nina.shah@medivio.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Dec 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: PO questions & request for updated SOW

Rishi / Olga,

Thanks — procurement here. A few items before we can issue a PO:
1) Can you provide the updated SOW with granular milestones and acceptance criteria?
2) Please include the revised SLA and a clarification about who owns backups during the pilot and production phase.
3) We require Redwood’s standard cyber insurance declaration and SOC2 letter of attestation (pdf) attached.

Once we have the amendment + SOW and the invoice format (line items), we’ll issue a PO. Please send to procurement@medivio.com.

—Tom Erickson
Procurement Manager — Medivio Health
From: olga_petrov@redwood.com
To: Tom Erickson <procurement@medivio.com>, Nina Shah <nina.shah@medivio.com>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2026 14:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PO questions & request for updated SOW

Tom — thanks. I’ve attached the amendment proposal (amendment-proposal-2026-12-03.pdf) and the deploy checklist; SOC2 and cyber insurance declaration are in the Drive folder linked below. We’ll add the milestone table and acceptance criteria to the SOW this afternoon and send an invoice template.

DocuSign link for the amendment: https://docusign.com/signed/abc123
Drive folder (artifacts): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3Cmedivio-rollforward
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-9876

If that looks good, please provide a PO number and billing contact and we’ll schedule the kickoff for Wed 12/15 to keep to your requested go‑live window in late January.

Best,
